summary: Milestone 2026.05.148 completed 10 experiments in 112.1 minutes, with 1 compute-bound experiment. The slowest measured path was the 41.3-minute compute-bound Exp 1890 activation-contract task, followed by the 39.5-minute synthesis-only retrospective and a 21.3-minute synthesis-only pre-gate block; GPU idle was not flagged on the compute-bound task.
bottlenecks_identified: The only compute-bound experiment in the supplied data was also the slowest path: Exp 1890 at 41.3 minutes. The timing block does not expose sub-phase timings, so the root cause cannot be isolated beyond the activation-contract workload itself.
Synthesis and closeout work occupied major slowest-five slots, led by the 39.5-minute Exp 1903 retrospective. This is not a GPU utilization issue because synthesis-only tasks have no GPU code path.

The same Exp 1894 pre-gate title appears multiple times in the slowest-five data. The provided blocks do not identify those records as doomed-rerun blocks, so the actionable issue is missing pre-gate sub-classification and timing, not GPU scheduling.
improvements_suggested: Add phase-level timers to activation-contract and retrospective tasks so future retros can separate planning, artifact writes, validation, and docs reconciliation.
Emit per-experiment GPU telemetry with compute_bound, model_count, and dual_gpu_required fields so GPU-idle findings are gated by the workload type instead of closeout snapshots.
Keep DualGPURunner enforcement conditional on concurrently loaded model count; the supplied data does not show a parallel-model compute-bound task in this milestone.
Make closeout artifact, changelog, and roadmap append operations idempotent so retrospective synthesis spends less time on reconciliation and duplicate detection.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Instrument activation-contract and retrospective tasks with subspan timing emitted into their result artifacts.
Add compute-bound GPU/model-count telemetry to the conductor closeout record before the operational retro runs.
Provide idempotent ops-doc append helpers for changelog and Completed Milestones updates.
meta_reflection: The supplied data supports one compute-bound slow path and substantial synthesis-closeout overhead, but it does not support a claim that idle GPUs wasted compute-bound work. The next retro would be more actionable if the conductor recorded per-phase timing and model-count telemetry for every compute-bound task.
